how: No bobsleigh or skeleton track exists in the Beijing urban area; the Yanqing National Sliding Centre (2022 Olympic track) is about 75 km northwest of the centre.
No ski jumping hill exists within the Beijing urban area; the nearest are in Zhangjiakou (Chongli), roughly 200 km northwest.
Camel racing needs camels and desert terrain; nothing comparable exists in the Beijing area (nearest in Inner Mongolia, several hundred km away).
Elephant polo requires working elephants, which are not kept in the Beijing area; it is played in Thailand, Nepal and India (5+ hour flights).

how: Cooper's Hill Cheese-Rolling is an annual event in Gloucestershire, England, with no equivalent in the Beijing area.
Buzkashi is a Central Asian horseback game not played in the Beijing area; the nearest comparable traditions are in Xinjiang, thousands of km away.
Beijing is inland with no ocean surf; the nearest coast (Bohai Sea at Tianjin or Qinhuangdao, 150-300 km) has little rideable surf.
Beijing is inland and has no mangroves or sea coast; the nearest sea kayaking is on the Bohai coast, 150+ km away.
Beijing is inland with no tidal flats; the nearest intertidal areas are on the Bohai coast near Tianjin, about 150 km away.
Beijing Cricket Club (expat-founded) fields teams in a local league and the BCC International Cricket Sixes; matches have been played at Dulwich College in Shunyi.
Beijing GAA, a multinational Gaelic games club, trains weekly at a school sports ground in the diplomatic area (2008-era report; current status unconfirmed).
The National Speed Skating Oval (Ice Ribbon) on the Olympic Green is open to the public on 'the fastest ice' in China, and Tsinghua and Beijing Sport University rinks also admit the public.

Beijing Sport University's ice centre has two curling lanes and the Ice Cube (National Aquatics Centre) hosted Olympic curling; public rinks such as Mencheng Lake in Mentougou have offered free curling and hockey tasters by reservation.

how: Beijing has multiple Olympic-standard hockey rinks, e.g. the CUPE Skating Rink, and university rinks open to the public.
Let's Climb is a dedicated bouldering gym of about 400 sq m with a two-storey mezzanine bouldering area.
Beijing Fashion Sports Park in Daxing houses park skateboarding and U-pool areas, and Burning Ice Skate Park in Xicheng has about 2,000 sq m of indoor skating.
Demeanor Equestrian runs English-style riding lessons (often one-on-one, foreign coaches invited) for riders including embassy families.
Kayak and paddleboard hire is available on the North Moat (Deshengmen to Andingmen) and Zhuanhe River, open 10:00-21:00 with life jackets required.
Stand-up paddleboards can be rented at the North Moat and Zhuanhe River starting piers (about 2 km routes each) from 10:00 to 21:00.
TBX Pickleball has five outdoor courts with floodlights and trainers near Sun Park, bookable through a WeChat mini-program at roughly RMB 88-138 per court-hour.
Sazon Cuban Dance School Beijing runs salsa and Cuban dance classes Monday to Saturday evenings.
Beijing Comedy Club hosts a free fortnightly Wednesday open mic at Hot Cat Club (five-minute sets), Giggle Bar has had a Thursday open mic, and Taps in Sanlitun hosts monthly comedy shows.
venue: Hot Cat Club (Beijing Comedy Club open mic)

how: Beijing Improv Group performs as house act at Hot Cat Club comedy nights (older listing; current schedule unconfirmed).
Beijing Chenyuen Scuba School (PADI) has an on-site training pool and offers an Open Water course with full equipment rental; no prior experience needed.
Jian Club in Sanlitun SOHO has 16 indoor lanes with 8-24 lb bows and free coaching for newcomers; Arrow Strike (Guomei First City) has 10 m and 18 m lanes with beginner bows.
Skyline Dance Lab in Sanlitun SOHO has eight poles and ran pole classes for all levels at RMB 150 (2015 review; current status unconfirmed).
Skyline Dance Lab in Sanlitun SOHO taught aerial silk and hoop classes at RMB 175 (2015 review; current status unconfirmed).
UCCA Beijing (798) ran adult drawing series for all levels including a figure-drawing session (2017 members' class; current programme unconfirmed).
CapoeiraBeijing ran kids' classes at East Gate Plaza with adult sessions following (2013 post; current schedule unconfirmed).
Hutong Calligraphy offers short English-language beginner calligraphy classes near Wangfujing, bookable through travel platforms.

Fragrant Hills Park (Xiangshan) in the Western Hills has a north route and a harder south route over Incense Burner Peak; Beijing Hikers also runs graded weekend group hikes, mostly on Great Wall sections farther out.
Beijing International Dragon Boat Club, founded in 2001 starting with foreign expats, fields teams for domestic and international races (training venue and current schedule unconfirmed).
Beijing Aardvarks (founded 1999) train at a grass pitch in Chaoyang, and Beijing Devils, Beijing Ducks and Beijing Brothers are other clubs in the local rugby scene.
Beijing Planetarium has two courtyard observatories with telescopes, and Tsinghua University's student astronomy society has held public observing open nights (2016 report).
Beijing Bilingual Tango School (BJBTango) teaches Argentine tango in Chinese and English, and the Westin Beijing Chaoyang listed tango classes with an Argentine teacher (older listing).
Beijing has a Lindy Hop scene and an annual Swingtime Ball, and Beijing Ballroom Dance Club has run drop-in swing classes before Saturday parties (older listing).

Olympic-style (WTF) taekwondo clubs are described as easy to find in Beijing, and the Beijing Sport University has hosted taekwondo classes taught by a former Korean national-team member (2006 forum thread).
The Friends of Latin America choir in Dongcheng sings in Chinese, Spanish and Portuguese for a membership fee of RMB 100 a year, and the French-linked Choral de Pekin meets weekly.
Sunshine Dance offers street dance classes and a team in Beijing (older listing); the Forbidden City Rockers are a long-running Beijing bboy crew.
Shangzhuang Reservoir northwest of downtown is the closest reservoir to the city and is popular for informal free angling from April to October.
